adjudication.rationale: The finding identifies a real issue in the diff. Looking at app/models/topic_embed.rb lines 19-27, there's a Topic.transaction block that wraps PostCreator.new().create and TopicEmbed.create!. The PostCreator class (shown in lib/post_creator.rb) performs various operations including publishing and potentially enqueuing jobs. If PostCreator publishes messages or enqueues background jobs before the outer transaction commits, those async consumers could try to access the TopicEmbed record that doesn't exist yet (since it's created after the post but still within the uncommitted transaction). This is a legitimate race condition/data consistency bug.
